about: Drop-in crafts run on the third Saturday of the month during museum hours, so there is no sign-up, and the December session has a holiday theme.
faq: Is Holiday Crafts at the Hayward Area Historical Society free?
The crafts are free and no reservations are required. Museum admission is a suggested $5 donation.
What time is storytime on December 19?
Storytime is at 11:00 am, and families can drop in for crafts between 11:30 am and 2:30 pm.

about: California Revels says it produces a Midwinter Revels every December to welcome the return of the light back from the darkness of winter.
faq: How much are Midwinter Revels tickets in Hayward?
Standard tickets are $35 for youth and $55 for adults. VIP tickets are $60 for youth and $80 for adults.
When are the Midwinter Revels shows in Hayward?
Shows run December 11 to 20, 2026, at the Douglas Morrisson Theatre: 7:30 pm on December 11, 17 and 18, and 1:00 pm and 6:00 pm on December 12, 13, 19 and 20.
